content.title: About
content.content: Instant coffee is a soluble coffee made from roasted and ground beans that are dried by spray‑drying or freeze‑drying. This version contains 50 % less caffeine than regular instant coffee and is intended for reconstitution – simply add hot water.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soluble coffee was first produced commercially in the early 20th century.
Caffeine reduction is achieved by selecting low‑caffeine bean varieties and partial decaffeination.
Reconstitution technology delivers a flavor profile close to freshly brewed coffee in seconds.
Instant coffee is convenient for travel, offices, and situations with limited access to fresh beans.
Packaging is usually airtight, preserving aroma and preventing oxidation.

items.title: Reduced fatigue
items.content: Even with half the caffeine, the drink still stimulates the central nervous system, helping to combat tiredness without a strong “jolt.”

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that act as antioxidants and may support cellular health.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Moderate caffeine can boost metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: Despite lower caffeine, the beverage retains the ability to enhance attention and cognitive performance.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Being water‑based, instant coffee provides a convenient way to hydrate while delivering a mild caffeine boost.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Even reduced caffeine can cause anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee may increase stomach acidity, which can be problematic for gastritis or reflux sufferers.

items.title: Additives and flavorings
items.content: Some brands add sugar, sweeteners, or flavorings that may not fit certain dietary preferences.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to coffee components can occur.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix 1‑2 teaspoons (≈5‑10 g) of powder with hot (not boiling) water, stir until fully dissolved. Add milk, plant‑based milk, or sweetener to taste if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed container to prevent moisture ingress. Properly stored, the product retains its aroma for up to 12 months.
